summary: The revised proposed scope closes the five round-1 High findings as originally stated. P1 is now one exact ad-video description reorder with a frozen original/proposed pair; the twelve-description census is supplied and the other eleven stay untouched. P2 is a read-only obligation/conflict map, AC4 no longer claims unambiguous source, and parent-only / no-subagent-TaskUpdate stays explicit. Separate cheaper implementation is pinned to mode=dispatch with the existing CREATE/MODIFY/blueprint contract required before execute-changeset, and this document correctly does not call itself that packet. P2 SKILL.md edits are deferred; eligibility-checks.json plus validate-skill-before-starting.sh show the heading is missing on the three files while the validator still passes on creation-date/family coverage, which matches the corrected F-004 mechanical claim. Validator and behavior.json stay byte-identical (IDs A–D), the model-mirror generator is prohibited, evaluate-rule is fully read-only, and D1–D12 remain unapproved. Negative evidence: ad-video-description.proposed.txt is a sentence permutation of description-baseline.json (Use when + Do not use moved intact to the front; every other sentence retained; body stays byte-identical). F-009’s attempt to treat P0 as the human owner is correctly rejected: DOCTRINE.md:1037 defines P0 as the virtual founder; S10 stays a parked D7 textual conflict, not a pilot edit. Remaining actionable gaps are new, not restatements: P3 still has no frozen hunks, so a dispatch executor can rewrite plan-changeset/execute-changeset contract language while hunting ‘stale model prose’; P4 still requires a SEV/owner distinguishing case this ad-video-only edit cannot test. This advisory follow-up is not an implementation receipt, not owner review topology, and not land/verify/install proof. Do not start execute-changeset until the P3 replacements are frozen and the dispatch packet is complete.

findings.analysis: Round-1 F-001 is closed for descriptions because P1 now freezes exact original and proposed text. P3 did not get the same treatment. The envelope names five whole files and says ‘replace unsupported unconditional family/version requirements with cognitive role and effective-policy resolution,’ ‘correct only non-generated prose,’ ‘do not invent current model pins,’ freeze generated blocks, freeze manually mirrored profile/model-ID tables and KIMI_DETACHED_CAPS, and allow replacing only the Host-Specific Resolutions table. That is a constraint list, not a patch. A separate cheaper implementer under mandatory mode=dispatch will author those replacements as CREATE/MODIFY content. The supplied plan-changeset excerpt already mixes forbidden-looking model tokens with contract that this revision just made sacred: `DISPATCH=mimo-pro|sonnet` is a transport identifier, and ‘Opus-priced double-spend’ sits inside the inline-vs-dispatch rule that F-003 required to stay intact. An executor grepping for Sonnet/Opus/currently can rewrite Execution Mode, §3a, or fail-closed unmarked mode while believing it is deleting stale pins. The Outcome line that this session’s resolver maps PLAN to Sol High and EXEC to Grok High is an observation, not svc-default; if copied into CLAUDE.md or model-routing.md it would contradict the frozen generated tables (PLAN Opus 4.8, EXEC Sonnet 5) and smuggle unapproved D12 into documentation. Host-Specific Resolutions may be replaced, but no replacement text is frozen, so ‘do not invent pins’ is an honor system. This is unresolved consequential wording (rubric 10) and inexact write scope (rubric 5) inside files that also hold complete dispatch/inline behavior (rubric 2). It is not a demand for a certified v4 packet in this planning request; it is the same class of freeze P1 already performed, required before a later execution handoff authors P3.

findings.analysis: Narrowing P1 to ad-video-script closed F-008 and the safety-clause half of F-001: the frozen proposed text only reorders that skill’s existing Use when, tagged-WI, and remux/I2V/audio-fix exclusion sentences. P4 nevertheless still lists ‘protected-owner/SEV exclusions survive description frontloading’ as a required distinguishing case, alongside the real ad-video cases (explicit invocation, negative non-target, tagged-WI, existing-cut exclusion). ad-video-script’s description has no SEV-1/2 human_checkpoint line and no owner-approval gate; those clauses live in untouched skills such as plan-blast-radius. A dispatch executor told to prove SEV survival has two bad paths: expand P1 to a SEV-bearing description (envelope leak, undoing F-008), or run a case against unchanged source and treat AC2’s security/approval boundary as demonstrated (vacuous proof). The validator/fixture freeze correctly prevents laundering that through skill-judgment IDs A–D; the leftover P4 case is still an executable success predicate that does not match the approved mutation. This is not a request to run paid Astra-vs-cheap benchmarks in this planning request; those stay unauthorized until a later implementation binds an existing evaluation transport. Trim the required cases to clauses this reorder actually moves.
